info.help:
usage: wgsextract info [-h] [--detailed] [--csv] <command> ...

positional arguments:
  <command>
    calculate-coverage  Generate a full breadth-of-coverage report. Uses samtools coverage to
                        calculate exactly how much of each chromosome was sequenced.
    coverage-sample     Quickly estimate per-chromosome breadth of coverage by sampling ~1,000
                        evenly spaced, length-weighted 1 kb windows. An estimate; use calculate-
                        coverage for exact numbers.
    chip                Identify the vendor, chip and revision of a consumer microarray raw-data
                        file (23andMe, AncestryDNA, MyHeritage, FTDNA, ...) from its header and
                        marker set, with a confidence score and the matching --formats template.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --detailed            Perform full index and body sample analysis (detailed mode)
  --csv                 Output the table as CSV instead of formatted text

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json, --quiet, --debug,
  --config and the other global options are accepted before or after the command; 'wgsextract
  --help' lists them all.

examples:
  wgsextract info --input sample.cram
  wgsextract info --input sample.cram --detailed

outputs (in the output directory unless noted):
  Prints a summary and caches it as <input file name>.wgse_info.json.

actions.help: show this help message and exit

                                       [--tree {yfull,yfull_v10,ftdna,isogg}]
                                       [--min-reads MIN_READS] [--base-quality BASE_QUALITY]
                                       [--base-majority BASE_MAJORITY] [--min-score MIN_SCORE]
                                       [--ancient] [--no-ref-inference] [--qc-min-depth DEPTH]
                                       [--tree-links]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pos-file POS_FILE   Yleaf position file (optional)

  --tree {yfull,yfull_v10,ftdna,isogg}

  --min-reads MIN_READS
  --base-quality BASE_QUALITY
  --base-majority BASE_MAJORITY
  --min-score MIN_SCORE

  --no-ref-inference    VCF: use genotyped positions only (targeted panels); otherwise --ref is
                        required.
  --qc-min-depth DEPTH  Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config
                        qc_min_diploid_depth 8, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)
  --tree-links          Print YFull and FTDNA tree links.

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json, --quiet, --debug,
  --config and the other global options are accepted before or after the command; 'wgsextract
  --help' lists them all.

examples:
  wgsextract lineage y-haplogroup --input sample.cram

outputs (in the output directory unless noted):
  yleaf/: hg_prediction.hg, the per-sample .out/.fmf/.info reports and
  run.json.

microarray.help:
usage: wgsextract microarray [-h] [--formats FORMATS] [--indel-manifest FORMAT=PATH]
                             [--strand-ambiguous {keep,no-call}]
                             [--resolve-rsids | --no-resolve-rsids] [--quirks {corrected,vendor}]
                             [--min-gq MIN_GQ] [--min-dp MIN_DP]
                             [--assume-hom-ref | --no-assume-hom-ref]
                             [--exclude-filtered | --no-exclude-filtered]
                             [--call-reasons | --no-call-reasons]
                             [--aadr-sample-id AADR_SAMPLE_ID] [--aadr-sex {U,M,F}]
                             [--parallel | --no-parallel] [--ref-vcf-tab REF_VCF_TAB]
                             [--ploidy-file PLOIDY_FILE] [--sample SAMPLE] [-r REGION]
                             [--qc-min-depth DEPTH]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --formats FORMATS     Comma-separated list of formats to generate (default: all).
                        Available formats:
                          Combined kit only (always written):
                            all (every chip's markers in one 23andMe-style file, e.g. for GEDmatch;
                            writes no vendor files: list the vendor formats to get them)
                          23andMe:
                            23andme_v2 (also v1: same markers), 23andme_v3, 23andme_v4, 23andme_v5,
                            23andme_v5_2025 (v5 chip as exported in 2025), 23andme_v3+v5, 23andme_api
                          AncestryDNA:
                            ancestry_v1, ancestry_v2, ancestry_v2_2021 (2021 V2.0 layout),
                            ancestry_v2_2024 (V2.0 chip as exported in 2024-25)
                          Family Tree DNA:
                            ftdna_v1 (Affymetrix, NCBI36 positions), ftdna_v2, ftdna_v3
                          Living DNA:
                            ldna_v1, ldna_v2
                          MyHeritage:
                            myheritage_v1, myheritage_v2,
                            myheritage_gsa_2025 (609,346 markers), myheritage_gsa_2025_609424
                          Nucleus:
                            nucleus (array export, 2025)
                          AADR v66.p1 (GRCh37 outputs, PLINK .bed/.bim/.fam AND EIGENSTRAT .geno/.snp/.ind):
                            aadr_1240k, aadr_ho, aadr_1240k+ho (HO is a subset of 1240K in this release)
                            aadr_2m (opt-in; first run 'ref aadr --install'; v66.p1 genetic distances
                              differ from legacy 1240K/HO at 1,200,251 sites; maps are never mixed)
  --indel-manifest FORMAT=PATH
                        Opt-in sequence-defined I/D probes from a matching GRCh37 Illumina CSV, gzip or ZIP; repeat per selected format
  --strand-ambiguous {keep,no-call}
                        Keep/no-call biallelic A/T or C/G input SNPs; unknown probe alleles are not inferred (default: config or keep)
  --resolve-rsids, --no-resolve-rsids
                        Resolve packaged dbSNP aliases and no-call retired/ambiguous marker IDs (default: config or false)
  --quirks {corrected,vendor}
                        corrected: forward-strand calls; vendor: reverse-strand calls where a template's vendor revision reported them so (default: config or corrected)
  --min-gq MIN_GQ       Minimum sample GQ; missing GQ becomes a no-call (default: config or 0, disabled)
  --min-dp MIN_DP       Minimum sample DP; missing DP becomes a no-call (default: config or 0, disabled)
  --assume-hom-ref, --no-assume-hom-ref
                        Assume absent VCF markers are reference on represented contigs (default: config or true)
  --exclude-filtered, --no-exclude-filtered
                        No-call VCF records failing FILTER (default: config or false)
  --call-reasons, --no-call-reasons
                        Also write CombinedKit_reasons.tsv with explicit reasons (default: config or false)
  --aadr-sample-id AADR_SAMPLE_ID
                        Non-identifying sample label for AADR .fam/.ind (default: sample)
  --aadr-sex {U,M,F}    AADR metadata sex only; does not change genotype calling (default: U)
  --parallel, --no-parallel
                        Call chromosomes in parallel workers (default: on with --threads above 1; calls are identical to one stream)
  --ref-vcf-tab REF_VCF_TAB
                        Master tabulated list of all consumer microarray SNPs (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)
  --ploidy-file PLOIDY_FILE
                        File defining ploidy per chromosome (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)
  --sample SAMPLE       Sample to use from a multi-sample VCF (e.g. a joint-called nf-core/sarek VCF); required when the VCF has more than one
  -r, --region REGION   Chromosomal region (e.g. chrM, chrY:10000-20000)
  --qc-min-depth DEPTH  Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config qc_min_diploid_depth 8, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json,
  --quiet, --debug, --config and the other global options are accepted before
  or after the command; 'wgsextract --help' lists them all.

examples:
  wgsextract microarray --input sample.cram --formats 23andme_v5
  wgsextract microarray --input sample.cram --formats 23andme_v5,ancestry_v2

outputs (in the output directory unless noted):
  <input stem>_<format>.txt (or the vendor's extension) per format, and <input
  stem>_CombinedKit.txt.

vcf indel.help:
usage: wgsextract vcf indel [-h] [--ploidy-file PLOIDY_FILE | --ploidy PLOIDY] [-r REGION]
                            [--parallel] [--qc-min-depth DEPTH]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ploidy-file PLOIDY_FILE
                        File defining ploidy per chromosome (auto-resolved from --ref if possible)
  --ploidy PLOIDY       Predefined ploidy name or value
  -r, --region REGION   Chromosomal region (e.g. chrM, chrY:10000-20000)
  --parallel            Call contigs in parallel with up to --threads workers. Faster, but calls
                        at sites deeper than 255 reads can differ slightly from the default single
                        stream, because bcftools subsamples them with one random stream per
                        process.
  --qc-min-depth DEPTH  Warn below this mean depth for this run; 0 disables (default: config
                        qc_min_diploid_depth 8, or qc_min_haploid_depth 3 for chrY/mtDNA)

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json, --quiet, --debug,
  --config and the other global options are accepted before or after the command; 'wgsextract
  --help' lists them all.

examples:
  wgsextract vcf indel --input sample.cram

outputs (in the output directory unless noted):
  indels.vcf.gz (+ .tbi).
